purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for connections, transport sessions, resolved peers, flow control and close/reconnect state.

owns: Connection and Transport Session Monitor semantics

topics.name: Connection and Transport Session Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for connections, transport sessions, resolved peers, flow control and close/reconnect state.

semantics.identity_rule: Connection, transport session, peer, IAM session and listener identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: close/block/reconnect operations invoke separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing transport state grants no application authority.
semantics.redaction_rule: Sensitive key/session material is structurally excluded.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: remote IP shown as verified identity

references.purpose: Monitor distinguishes endpoint evidence from peer identity.
